$comment: Figures beyond the generated corpus for npm run bench:lines. Each entry points at a label JSON, relative to this file (format: bench/lines/truth.ts): knownValues plateaus become partial truth; a points list (polyline with a marker on every data point) becomes full truth for the line and its markers; markerSeries (scatter groups) full marker truth. Labels are shared with the e2e fixtures and bench:axes. `source` is the top category (default real); tags become categories.
